dialogues.speaker: Huffman
dialogues.text: Oh? You've already met my brother? Then I don't think there's much to say.

dialogues.speaker: Huffman
dialogues.text: I was so worried about him when he went out with the Grand Master. But now it seems I was too worried.

dialogues.speaker: Huffman
dialogues.text: Although he is still prone to shyness, his ability to survey and do mapping has improved a lot, and his work is done in short order.

dialogues.speaker: Huffman
dialogues.text: I hear he's joining the Guerrilla Assault platoon next, and he probably won't be back in town for a while. I wish him all the best!
